incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD alert PD123456 — latency_sla_ratio > 0.9 in us-west-1. Routing to oncall.
elena: acked. i'm on it :headphones:
sam: @elena thx. seeing a ~500ms p95 bump on router-usw1, p50 fine. any 5xxs?
elena: no 5xxs in the last 5m per console. runs a quick query:
```
# prometheus-ish
sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{region="us-west-1"}[1m])) by (le)
```
elena: looks like a short-lived tail spike coincident with a batch of KV cold fills — some pods show elevated kv_get latency.
pagerduty: Alert PD123456 was acknowledged by elena.
maria: any customer impact? logged errors? :eyes:
elena: checked logs and traces — only internal health-checks and warms. no customer-facing errors, no spike in rps, small subset of backend workers saw latency. marking as likely no-customer-impact for now.
ryan: FYI we had a small canary push ~8m ago that replaced a few infra nodes in usw1. maybe kv caches restarted.
elena: warming caches on the affected deployment with one-off command:
```
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/warmup?deployment=router-usw1
```
elena: kicked warmup, watching.
sam: thanks. i'm cross-checking infra autoscaler logs — some pods restarted around the same time.
elena: incident-bot: note: warming completed for 4/4 targets. p95 returned to baseline.
incident-bot: Alert PD123456 auto-resolved (no further triggers) — closed by monitoring.
elena: confirmed resolved. no customer impact. reopening if anything reappears.
maria: can we tune the PD rule or add a short suppression for kv-warmup bloom? low effort, reduces noise.
ryan: i can open a follow-up ticket to add a cooldown and add a kv-prefill step to the canary workflow.
elena: please do. add a short playbook snippet for oncall: run warmup command if p95 spike + no 5xxs.
sam: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
elena: closing thread. will link the follow-up ticket once created. :white_check_mark:
